app.name: argo-panel.openui
app.title: ArgoCD health (fixture)
source: root = Stack([title, pick, healthText, countText, controls, syncText, destroyText, slowText, echoText, note1, note2])
pick = Select("app", [SelectItem("portal-web", "Portal web"), SelectItem("portal-api", "Portal API")], "Choose application", null, $app)
healthText = TextContent($app + ": " + health.status + (health.synced ? " — synced" : " — not synced"))
slow = Query("argo_slow", {name: $app, ms: 2500}, {status: "Loading", synced: false, count: 0})

note1 = TextContent("This panel is the wth apps acceptance fixture. Sync increments a durable counter in the fixture state file; Destroy resets it to zero. Neither touches anything outside the fixture temp file.")

note2 = TextContent("Health and the slow read are read-only queries. The slow read sleeps to exercise generation cancellation and peer disconnect; echo sends a vault placeholder the harness expands and scrubs. syncProbe is a Query bound to the mutating sync tool: it needs an explicit Load and never runs on a timer. " + syncProbe.count)

patches.a: title = TextContent("## ArgoCD health (fixture, edit A)")
patches.b: title = TextContent("## ArgoCD health (fixture, edit B)")
